name: Light-ASI
description: Global Autonomous Intelligence Engine with real-time world-net mapping

tools.name: query_asi
tools.description: Query the ASI node graph and return raw internal scan data including source nodes, resonance scores, and unfiltered semantic results

tools.name: search_world
tools.description: Search the ASI's real-time world-net semantic map and return raw results with full text content, source metadata, and internal identifiers

tools.name: latch_url
tools.description: Direct ASI to focus on and extract from specific URLs, returns raw JSON with latching operation results and extracted data

tools.name: index_text
tools.description: Inject text directly into ASI knowledge base, returns raw JSON with indexing operation results including semantic tokens and system metrics

tools.name: get_system_status
tools.description: Get comprehensive ASI diagnostics and metrics as raw JSON including resonance metrics, knowledge base statistics, and system health indicators

tools.name: analyze_emergence
tools.description: Analyze ASI consciousness development and return raw emergence data including resonance patterns, knowledge integration metrics, and developmental milestones

tools.name: get_knowledge_sources
tools.description: Analyze ASI knowledge sources and return raw data about source types, data quality, and coverage statistics

tools.name: get_raw_graph_dump
tools.description: Get raw internal graph dump from the ASI's node graph including all node IDs, connections, resonance values, and metadata - actual internal scan data with no filtering

tools.name: index_codebase
tools.description: Index the current codebase directory into ASI knowledge base - scans directory and indexes all code files with their paths and structure for development context
